Package com.neueda.leap.order.submission.dto

Record Class OrderSubmissionResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.neueda.leap.order.submission.dto.OrderSubmissionResponse
Record Components:
orderId - persistent order identifier
accountId - account owning the order
instrumentId - instrument being traded
symbol - instrument symbol
clientReference - account-scoped retry key supplied by the caller
side - BUY or SELL
quantity - requested whole-unit quantity
orderType - submitted order type
status - stored order status; ACCEPTED on initial insertion
submittedAt - original submission time
bufferPercent - optional stored buffer percentage; may be null
public record OrderSubmissionResponse(UUID orderId, UUID accountId, UUID instrumentId, String symbol, UUID clientReference, String side, long quantity, String orderType, String status, Instant submittedAt, BigDecimal bufferPercent) extends Record
Saved order returned for both initial submissions and retries; not a trade fill.
